t_more: Showing the first {n} - narrow the search to see more.
s_hint: Check the status page first - most 2096xx errors just mean the server is unreachable.
s_i1: Uninstall the original Wii Shop Channel first. The replacement uses the same title ID, so installing over it can conflict.
s_i2: If you used another shop patcher before, remove its patched IOS56 before installing ours.
s_i3: If your WAD manager says -1022 or -1029, delete the existing title, then install.
s_i4: Install the latest WAD. An old WAD gives errors even when the server is up.
s_i5: Accept the Wii user agreements (Wii Settings > Internet > User Agreements). If it says "not offered", temporarily set your country to the US or UK.
s_i6: Installing titles to an SD card needs a patched IOS80.
s_points_p: Card numbers are 16 characters. Enter them without dashes. Paste yours here to clean it up:
s_k1: Titles do not download on Dolphin - a real console NAND is needed for the shop.
s_k2: If the shop freezes after buying points and buttons turn grey, restart the channel - the points are still added.
s_k3: "This channel can't be used" or a black screen on a title: install Priiloader and enable Region Free EVERYTHING.
s_k4: Shop freezes on launch: remove the SD card first.
s_k5: Gifts work between friend codes (see the Friends page). Error 109139 usually means Gift was pressed instead of Download.
s_k6: Changing region with a "globe changer" tool often causes 205100 / 205958 - set a standard country instead.
s_k7: DLC works only for supported titles and may show as "downloadable" for the whole pack.
s_k8: Wii Sports and other disc games cannot be downloaded - only WiiWare, Virtual Console and channels.
s_before: Before you ask for help, include
s_b2: The error code and what you did just before it
s_b3: How the console connects (WiFi / ethernet adapter)
e_204034: Invalid web service response from the server. Usually a backend problem - retry later and report what you were doing.
e_204036: Problem importing the title. Try another title; if only one fails, report it with its name.
e_204058: The install would exceed the system memory blocks. Free up Wii memory or install to the SD card (needs patched IOS80).
e_201022: The downloaded content does not match the title metadata. Retry the download; if it repeats, report the title.
e_205100: No matching content for the offer, or missing request data. Often caused by a changed console region - set a standard country.
e_205502: Missing list offset in the catalog request. Seen when updating a preinstalled channel such as Photo Channel 1.1.
e_205151: Unknown error, usually at the 'Registering...' step. Common after restoring a NAND or with an old WAD - install the newest WAD and retry.
e_205958: Unknown error. Seen on consoles with a changed or mixed region or language - set a standard country and language.
e_209600: Connection timeout: the shop took too long to load. Check the status page.
e_209601: Connection timeout: the shop took too long to load. Check the status page, your network, and that you have the newest WAD.
e_209557: Timeout between the console and the server. Check status, then network, then the newest WAD.
e_109139: You most likely pressed Gift instead of Download.
e_51330: Router not supported. The Wii needs a 2.4 GHz signal with 802.11b/g/n enabled and security set to WPA2-PSK (AES) or lower.
e_51331: Unable to connect to the server. Check your router settings (2.4 GHz, WPA2-PSK AES) and the status page.
e_http: HTTP status error {n}. The server rejected the request - report what you were doing.
e_server: Server unreachable or being migrated. Check the status page and install the newest WAD.
e_conn: Connection problem on your side. Run a connection test in Wii Settings (on vWii, make sure Wii Settings is reachable).
e_backend: Backend server problem, not your setup. Report it and say what you were doing.
e_unknown: Unknown code. Post it with your console type and connection method.
st_sim: Simulated outage: the page is checking a server address that cannot answer.
st_help: Down for you but up here? See Support (DNS 8.8.8.8 / 8.8.4.4, latest WAD).
